scores.notes: Peter leaps from the boat wrapped in his coat while the shirtless beloved disciple points; Jesus stands by the charcoal fire on the right shore. No text, full bleed, anatomy sound.
Hezekiah in a blue royal robe with open hands at the carved temple doors, priests nearby, bronze basins on oxen in the court. No lettering seen; painted to the edges.

Folded newspaper (lower right) and a pinned wall note carry pseudo-text strokes. Holmes's gaunt profile with swept-back hair and curved pipe reads as Peter Cushing's screen Holmes. White deckled margins are accepted.
Peter dives from the bow with arms out and cloak flying, a young disciple points, and Jesus stands on the shore by the fire at dawn. Clean edges, no text.
Golden light pours through the city gate onto the townsfolk, and Wisdom is not drawn as a figure. A wall plaque at right (about x1095,y380) shows faint glyph scribbles.
The Levite stands over the woman's whole, uncut body with a knife, a lamp on the bench and the donkey in the doorway. Restrained, no gore, painted to the edges.

The priest kneels at the bronze altar over the dove's feathers on the ash. Moses holds two staffs at once, a crook in his right hand and a straight staff in his left, so the object is duplicated. The woven cherubim on the tent curtains are decoration, not figures.
Disciples bail with bowls in a swamped boat at night while Jesus sleeps on a cushion in the stern, with other boats nearby. No text; hands are fine.

Five men appear for a cast of four (two at left, Watson, Holmes, and another peering at right). Watson kneels on top of the crate he should hide behind, and Holmes's lantern is unshuttered. The thin ink rule border is plain, not ornamental; the white margin is accepted.

The Caterpillar has a humanlike face and wears a bowler hat, shirt and waistcoat, dress the text never gives it, against the talking-animal rule. Its hookah vessel is also missing. Alice and the mushroom clearing are otherwise right.
Saul clutches his head under a burst of cloudy radiance with no figure in it; companions stumble back and donkeys stand beside them, Damascus in the distance. No text.
Young David at the brook holds a staff with the sling and bag at his side; Goliath in scale armour with his shield bearer, Israelite soldiers on the slope. White paper edges are accepted.
The Cheshire Cat appears with its whole body, not only the head the text allows. The lying flamingo has three legs. The card soldiers on the arch carry suit-pip glyphs.
Roman soldiers crouch casting dice over garments, with the crucified Jesus distant on the cross and a blank titulus. No gore; the dice pips are plain dots. White paper edges are accepted.

Boaz grips two staffs at once, one diagonal in his right hand and one upright in his left. An unrequested bearded man sits among the women at left. Ruth, Boaz, the boy and Naomi sit in the courtyard as asked.
Peter steps from the boat onto the waves toward Jesus, who stands on the water holding a glowing lantern at night, disciples in the boat. No text; painted to the edges.
Moses with his staff leads Israelites carrying children between towering walls of water, with a fire-and-cloud pillar far behind. The view is from the front, not from behind, but the scene reads.
Egyptian chariots and horsemen charge down the seabed between walls of water under a dark dawn sky. The harnesses and horses read correctly, and there is no text.
Moses raises his rod at the cliff as water gushes out; Aaron in the priestly breastplate, with people, goats, sheep and donkeys drinking, tents beyond. White edges are accepted.

From inside the tomb, Jesus stands within the tomb mouth calling out while the bound Lazarus already stands outside among the crowd, so the positions are reversed. Martha and the mourners are present. White side edges are accepted.
The White Rabbit's scroll shows pseudo-handwriting lines, and the card courtiers carry suit-pip glyphs. The King, Queen, Alice and the animal jury with slates are present.
The Mock Turtle treads on Alice's toes as the Gryphon dances on the shingle beach; jellyfish in the surf, no text. White left and top edges are accepted.

Holmes inspects the battered hat with a lens while Watson watches by the fire, but papers pinned on the wall and shelves carry faint pseudo-text. Holmes's gaunt, swept-back profile again resembles Peter Cushing's screen Holmes.
The foreground stone markers carry carved pseudo-letters (for example 'ΔVA ACPANI'), and a small blank grey square sits in the top-right corner. Villagers and a Roman soldier walk the road as asked.

One seraph already holds tongs with a live coal, an element of a later verse. The seraphim's feet are bare and uncovered, and one covers its face with its hands, not its wings. God appears only as fire.

Watson crouches behind a crate with the revolver on top, Holmes holds a lantern, and Jones and Merryweather stand at the back. The crates carry stencilled pseudo-text (right side), and Holmes's face closely resembles Peter Cushing.
